__broaden__.ἐλθόντ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντα): ’coming’ · also aor. part. masc. dual nom., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντε): ’the two having come’
__broaden__.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’)
__broaden__.ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ · also masc. nom. sg., agreeing with πάϊς: ’my own’
__broaden__.ἐσθλῆς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, fine; fem. gen. sg., with δαιτός · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with an understood βουλῆς: ’of good (counsel)’
